candidates.instruction: In `axil_regbank`, replace the three repeated indexed `case` write branches for registers 0–2 with shared register-select and per-byte write-enable terms derived from `wr_en`, `wr_idx`, and `wr_strb`, then use those enables to update each byte from the corresponding `wr_data` byte. Preserve hold behavior for disabled lanes, the other write destinations, write counting, IRQ set/clear priority, reset values, and registered outputs. Keep the top interface and its unknown numeric latency unchanged; retain the candidate only if the fixed simulation and all gates pass, routed WNS and WHS remain nonn
